text.en:
BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE No. S 21 AIR NAVIGATION ACT (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1997 In exercise of the power conferred by paragraph (a) of section 4 of the Air Navigation Act, His Majesty The Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan hereby makes the following Order - Citation. 1. This Order may be cited as the Air Navigation Act (Amendment) Order, 1997. Amendment of 2. The Schedule to the Air Navigation Act is amended by deleting the Schedule to item commencing "S11977 No. 422" and by substituting thereforChapter 113. "S11989 The Air Navigation The whole References to Her No. 2395 (Overseas Territories) Majesty shall be Order, 1989 construed as references to His Majesty The Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan.". Made this 23rd. day of Rabiulawal, 1418 Hijrah corresponding to the 28th. day of July, 1997 Masihi at Our Istana Nurul !man, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM Dicetak oleh DATO PADUKA HAJI ALI BIN HAJI HASSAN, Pengarah Percetakan, di Jabatan Percetakan Kerajaan, Kementerian Undang-Undang, Negara Brunei Darussalam. Harga B$5.00
